title: NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment
applicability: Required on initial and recurring NFC tokenized transactions and for MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.
source: docs/specs/extracted_text.txt 12.19 NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment
scopeNote: Core-structure baseline: Segment Type/Length and trigger/response fields only. Not field-by-field exhaustive.

businessRequirements.title: Segment Type field in the NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment has fixed value 123.
Segment Length identifies the NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators.
Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.
Token PAN Suffix (Element 197) is returned in the response only if supplied by the authorizer.

testCases.positive: Segment 123 present on tokenized initial/recurring transactions
negative: Segment 123 omitted on a tokenized transaction requiring it

testDataStatus: Segment Type/Length structural checks are synthesizable. Token PAN Suffix authenticity requires a real token/authorizer response and cannot be synthesized (EXTERNAL_FIXTURE_REQUIRED).
remaining: Author full field-by-field NFC Payment Tokenization coverage (CAVV Revised Format, Token Requestor ID) beyond this core-structure baseline.
